messages:
oliver-eng: deploy-bot flagged embeddings route (emb-route:v2.1.3) during late window. p95 +25% and errors ~1.8%. deploy-bot recommends AUTO_REVERT. @kai-oncall @maya-sre thoughts?

deploy-bot: ALERT -> AUTOREVERT_RECOMMENDED. Triggers: p95>190ms for 4m, error_rate>1.5% for 3m. Canary=10%. Options: AUTOREVERT or HUMAN_ROLLBACK.

maya-sre: Pulling region split and raw traces. If it's concentrated we can manual rollback to avoid autopilot noise.

ops-bot: telemetry: us-west-2=75% canary traffic, p95_usw2=220ms, p95_eu=165ms, error_rate=1.8%. No infra alerts. Logs show increased model latency on runtime-node-gpu-07.

ron-prod: Dedicated customers on this route. Manual rollback + pin preferred so pools don't flip. Also need brief release-note entry.

kai-oncall: I'll take it. Plan: 1) freeze canary slice, 2) pin to emb-route:v2.1.2, 3) set deploy-bot.autopilot_disabled, 4) run rollback playbook, monitor 10m. Maya, can you run the commands?

maya-sre: running now:
```
deployctl traffic pause --release emb-route:v2.1.3 --slice canary
deployctl release pin --service embeddings --version v2.1.2 --reason "rollback: late-window latency/error spike"
deployctl annotate --release emb-route:v2.1.3 autopilot_disabled=true
```

ops-bot: checklist updated and runbook link posted: https://wiki.redwood/ops/rollback-embeddings.

maya-sre: pause done, pin applied, autopilot disabled. initiating rollback job rb-49876.

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual rollback initiated by maya-sre; autopilot suppressed by flag.

maya-sre: rollback progressing, replicas returning to v2.1.2; p95_usw2 down to 155ms after 3m, error_rate 0.4%. Monitoring 10m.

kai-oncall: Good. Ron please notify Dedicated owners to hold pools at v2.1.2 until RCA. Zoe, can you draft customer note?

zoe-pm: Drafted one-liner in #customer-comms. Will send after ops confirms stability.

maya-sre: 10m monitor complete. Stability restored. Closing rb-49876.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-49876 created for follow-up assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime.

oliver-eng: Release notes updated: "Rolled back embeddings emb-route:v2.1.3 to v2.1.2 due to post-deploy latency and error increase during late change window; investigation ongoing." Pin locked 24h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
